amendment_note: 2026-08-05b: bespoke staking re-registered before any graded outcome (zero settlements at time of change); gates, tiers, counting rules unchanged; cohort continues
selection_side: side with larger calibrated market-only EV at the entry quote

A.description: The audited frozen policy. Paper-staked at Kelly sizing; the only tier eligible for a future real-money decision.

B.description: Pre-registered expansion cohort (paper only, flat $50 units). Catches most deployed-pipeline drift from the audited policy: MOV-MKT-2 parity vs the shipped MOV-HOLD-1 artifact is 91.6% (7/8 shipped-only-A rows meet exact B gates). B never enters the promotion cohort retrospectively.

execution.rule: minimum acceptable decimal price = 1.02 / p_market. Bet only at or above it. Below it: pass. No chasing, no rescoring on price moves, no rebets.
counts_prospective_rules: discovery_lag_h <= 168 (line first seen within 7 days of scoring)

sizing.kelly_price_basis: captured executable fill price only (paper_filled rows); a signal whose best captured price is below the minimum acceptable price has NO fill, NO stake, NO ROI
sizing.event_allocation: NO event cap (fight outcomes on a card are ~independent). Circuit breaker only: total A-tier stake open at once <= open_exposure_ceiling; a batch that would exceed it scales proportionally; placed stakes never resize
sizing.note: amendment 2026-08-05b: bespoke staking derived from this strategy's own qualifier stream (favorite-heavy, ~87% win rate) via variant simulation (see STAKING.md); replaces proof-stage caps inherited from the backtest registry

cohorts: tier x side (favorite/underdog) tracked separately; dogs are IN per user decision 2026-08-05, small-sample caveat pre-registered
primary metric: realized CLV vs Pinnacle close; secondary: CLV vs retail consensus close; ROI monitored, not gating
rules: hold to settlement; no exits, hedges, or rebets
one signal per pair per event, scored at first sighting with known start time
model features use the frozen open; EV gate and min price use the entry quote
no retuning of model, gates, or sizing during the run; scheduled refit restarts nothing if gates unchanged (see PREREG)

remediation.roi_cohort_rule: paper ROI/staking evidence counts only for paper_filled signals scored at/after remediation_ts; earlier rows remain descriptive (CLV only)
